This lemma was originally used in the proof of a criterion for
openness of versality
(Artin's Axioms, Lemma <REF_0001>) but it
got replaced by Artin's Axioms, Lemma <REF_0002>
from which it readily follows. Namely,
after replacing <MATH_0001>, <MATH_0002> by a subsequence we may and do
assume that there are no specializations among these points, see
Properties, Lemma <REF_0003>.
Then we can apply
Artin's Axioms, Lemma <REF_0004>
to finish the proof.
